title: Installed from the tap on this Mac (rhad)
objective: On rhad, with nothing installed from a checkout for the proof, brew tap matthewsinclair/devbin and brew install devbin fetch over the formula's ssh url (the network half 0195 did not rehearse); brew test devbin passes and the devbin on PATH is the keg's; brew audit --strict is read and each finding fixed or accepted with its reason.
